nom: Philosophy The Microdelivery Triple-Acid Brightening Peel

avis.texte: I love this product. I bought this product when it was on sale and have only used it once every other week because of how strong but also privey it is. I have melanated skin and this left my skin feeling slightly tacky but the GLOW that I got from this product was insane. I have combination skin so i normally dont care for dewy/ glow products but this really helped to balance my skin and give me a nice glow. I cant say it helped with hyperpigmentation because I was not able to use this past two months due to the price.

I have very sensitive skin so I was worried this was going to cause a bad reaction and peeling - turns out i had nothing to worry about; this stuff did nothing. No changes whatsoever to dark spots or to anything at all. No peeling of any sort! Might as well have thrown my money directly in the trash.

This is the third box of these I have ordered that when you open the individual packet, the pad is discolored and smells awful. Like it is expired. Pretty disappointed. I also noticed that you are not able to purchase this item on the Philosophy website, they do not list it. Not sure if this is a legit product for them. The Vitamin C scrub is much better.

I have used these peel pads for several years on a weekly basis and love how my skin feels after. Just wish my local Southeast Michigan stores would carry them again, and they are often out of stock online. Please continue to offer.

I never in my life have had a bad reaction to a skincare product but within a minute after using this my entire face was burning and BRIGHT red. It was redder than a bad sunburn. Absolutely awful stay away from this product.

avis.titre: Only wish it was in stock.
avis.texte: Great product. Always out of stock. The single use package is wasteful but great for travel.

I have tried dozens of peesl and this is the most effective, convenient and affordable peel. It does it says with fast results but like anything the more you use it the better the results. Will continue to use.
I see a noticeable difference in my skin texture. Love this product!
First time using, and immediately afterwards I can see a brightness to my skin. Cannot wait to see if my uneveness is gone after the 12 uses!
I have been using this for years. I hope it is never discontinued. The result after just one use is amazing. Skin is smoother and radiant.

avis.titre: Best brightening peel I have ever used
avis.texte: I have been using this product weekly for several years. It works as described to brighten my skin and combats aging issues (I am 66). It is so simple to use and I would highly recommend it. Just wish Ulta would start carrying it again in their stores in Southeast Michigan. Good thing I can buy online

I've used the microdelivery triple-acid brightening peel for years. Once a week, this facial treatment helps keep my complexion bright without expensive, regular salon treatments. I love philosophy products!
I've been using these peels for at least 10 years now. They're pretty pricey, but most definitely worth every penny!

I love these pads and they are the easiest product to use. Every Sunday evening I've used a pad right after cleansing. I usually do not need moisturizer. I'm 67 years and using Philosophy has helped my skin for sure.
I use this weekly and it does a great job without drying out or irritating my skin.

I was recommended this micro delivery from a friend and it works wonders. I have always just used face moisturizers and needed something to help my mid 30's skin come back to life. This has helped aid in removing sun spots, old acne spots and added an overall glow to my skin. I am on my 3rd month using once weekly as advised.

Micro-delivery triple acid Brightening peel is great at making my skin feel smooth, lightens up dark spots and makes the skin look brighter. I wish they were at a lower price but my mother loves them so I purchased them for mother's day.
Cleared up my acne, brightens, evens tone, and seems to help with oily skin without making it dry. I use it every other day, it is amazing.
Been using for a month now and not much is happening. Still stings when applied.
I use this product weekly and it really does brighten my skin and just makes it look fresher the next day. This is the best peel product I have ever used.

avis.titre: Best home chemical peel!! Wow Amazing!!
avis.texte: I have only used this peel twice, once a week. With moisturizer afterwards. I can actually feel some of my dead skin lift. I have dark spots, that are lighter with only 2 applications. Wow!! I got it as a gift and will be purchasing more. My face, is so softer. My makeup looks much smoother. I am 54.

avis.titre: Good product to tone skin; a bit too shiny for me
avis.texte: Nice product; leaves skin soft but also shinier than I'd expected.
I have been using the triple-acid brightening peel for years and I love it!!!
been using this for a few years. Only once a month on this 60+ year old face. Keeps my face clear of blemishes (yes I still get those) and fine lines.

I started using this product about 1.5 years ago and it has made a tremendous difference to skin. It is brighter and my dark spots have diminished. I used it once a week religiously and was upset when it was out of stock for a while. So happy that it is back in stock!
But I used this product twice a week for 6 weeks and my skin has changed drastically! My dark spots have faded and my skin looks brighter and more even overall, definitely buying another pack ASAP!

I have only used 2 of the 12 pads so far and I already notice a difference in my skin-it's brighter and smoother-I use at night before I go to sleep once a week as directed-I can't wait to see the difference after 12 treatments-I will definitely purchase again.
I have used Microdelivery once a week for over 10 years, I love it!! It is one of my have to have Philosophy products!
I've been using this product for many years and continue to purchase it over and over again.
I loved this so much! My skin felt bright and glowy. It evened out my skin tone. Would definitely purchase again.
This acid peel is my once-a-week go to for brighter, better skin. Don't forget neck and decollete!
These are so very good. And this deliveres. My skin looks so good. So worth the investment for me. And after using on my face and neck I use on the back of my hands. Alright then!
I think it did make an immediate difference with my dullness and uneven skin tone. I only wish it helped more with dark spots.

I got this product 12 weeks ago to help with my melasma. Honestly I did not think I would see results so I took a before picture so I could see if there was a difference... wow. HUGE change and I'm so happy! This will not task away your brown spots BUT it drastically fades them abs your complexion becomes so bright and beautiful. I'm hooked.

I've enjoyed using these products however the scent as a little off taking. I've been using it six times now and it does show a slight Improvement however I will give a full detail after all of them have been used. My skin is extremely soft however there are sun spots on my skin still. If this doesn't workto my satisfaction I will have to go back to laser surgery
It is quick and seems to work. Smell is strong but it doesn't bother me.
I absolutely love this it makes your skin so bright & clears up acne. I deff recommend using it...u will love it

I have been using this for years. Body wash, shampoo and conditioner, and perfume. It seems like it doesn't smell as good as it once did. Something is changed. I have friends that have said the same. It's sad. It was once such a great Product.
I've been using this product for years. Your skin feels soft and pores look less visible after use.

So, I am nearing the end of two boxes of this incredible product--that is 24 weeks of use--that has turned my skin around! At 40, I have a history of abuse on my fair skin with regular beach trips--hello freckles and brown spots. However, for the first time in a decade, I am not wearing foundation of any type--it feels so liberating! I wish I had started using this in my 30s! Also, anyone that suffers from occassional acne due to hormones--this takes care of it :)

I have been using these pads for 4 years and can't live without them . I use it on clean skin at night twice per week. I sleep with only this on my skin, allowing my skin to just breath. In the morning I awake to a healthy glow.

I love this peel. I figured it would take a long time for me to notice any significant difference but I was wrong. I've tried many of products like this within all prices ranged and this one is my favorite. A little pricey but worth it.

These are an investment and they are worth e v e r y penny! I use them one night a week and, over time, the difference of your skin is undeniable. My pores are smaller and my skin is softer; it has, a sort of, glow now. I use one pad on my face, chest, neck, and the back of my hands. As a 50 something, I love this product!
I love this peel it really works. It is well worth the money.

I would not purchase this product!! I do not have sensitive skin and within a few minutes after using one pad my whole face turned completely red! It looks like i got a really bad reaction. I do not recommend product. I tried washing my face with cold water but the red has not faded.
I have been using this product for a couple if years and really love it. I see the difference it has made on my skin.
After using this once a week for a few months I noticed I looked really good. It definitely brightened my face and I just looked the absolute best I ever could.

After using multiple product form Philosophy, I decided to try Microdelivery peel. During summer I tend to break out more and dark spots due to sun n hot weather. Using Microdelivery once a week help clear my skin and keeps it white and bright. I recommend this product very much.
I have used this product and because I remember the results, I return to this site today after 1 yr of previous one time experience.
This helps with my hyperpigmentation marks big time. It also really brightens my skin and removes dead skin. Leaves my skin super soft. #skincare

I started using these and they have improved my complexion SO much! My skin is brighter, smoother and so soft now. It has also lessened my lines. I can't believe how much they helped. You can't go wrong using these!
I purchased the microdelivery wipes as a gift of beauty for myself. After week 1 my face is definitely brighter, my pours see! Smaller. I will post again at week 6.
I use hers every Sunday. I look forward to how healthy and taut my skin feels now that these are part of my routine.
Against my better judgement I ordered the new pads. The old pads were a 1 time use full on skin changer. This is no different than a toner.

These are my fav beauty product. When I return from traveling, in winter weather or just when I need a facial but don't have the time, these transform my skin from rough and bumpy to smooth and renewed. I follow up with some retinol/glycol lotion (these pads open your pores to allow moisture to really get in deep) and it's awesome. Use what's left on the back of your hands too.

I bought these in the outlet to try them and I love them, they don't burn my skin or leave my skin dry and peeling instead they leave my skin soft and glowing. I would buy them again if they are available when I run out!!!!
I recently purchased this product and have been faithfully using this product once a week. It's very easy to use and i noticed my hyperpigmentation is not as prominent as before.
I have been using these pads weekly for several years. They definitely have improved the appearance of my skin.

After one use I noticed such a difference. People have complimented I have a "glowing complexion" and my credit goes to this product. I would like to mention in my experience if I am through around my chin area it becomes irritated so be gentle and only use as often as stated on box.
I've been using these ever since they came out and love what they do to my face. Everyone comments on how great my skin looks.

I tried to get over the nasty smell and how sticky it felt because I was hoping I would get results. I have a few new brown spots and an uneven/dull complexion. Unfortunately not only did I not see results but it almost seemed like one of my spots got darker despite lack of sun and of course daily use of sunscreen. Sadly my before pics seem to have been deleted but posting a few afters following the 12 week treatment.
Please don't stop carrying these, they are my favorite. I've been using them for years on my 50+ skin.

This product delivers! I use weekly and have noticed a change for the better with my skin. My skin is more radiant and improvement with wrinkles. Don't forget when you wipe over your face to wipe the back of your hands with the peel pad. I have also noticed an improvement with dark spots on my skin. I have very sensitive skin and have not experienced any type of discomfort on my skin. A weekly staple that I will continue to use.

avis.titre: Philosophy Microdelivery Tripple Acid Brightening Peel
avis.texte: Awesome Product!!! I could see a big difference and improvement, even after the first time using this product. I will definitely purchase this again.

I received a sample of the brightening pads. Applied to face and neck as directed, turned bright red within 30 seconds and my skin started to burn. Rinsed off with cold water and an hour later, I'm still bright red and splotchy, and everything burns. I do not have sensitive skin and have never reacted like this to acids or peels.

This is by far my favorite peel ever. It's super simple, takes two minutes to apply, and I can feel it working (yet it doesn't burn.) My skin has never looked smoother or more even since I started using these peel pads. I've been using them for 10 months, 1-2 times per week. I cannot recommend them highly enough if you are concerned with dullness, unevenness, texture, or discoloration.

I've been using and loving the Microdelivery Exfoliating Peel for at least 10 years and loving it. I decided to try this instead because over the past couple of years I've noticed that I don't seem to get that wow, super soft feeling quite like I used to from the Micro Ex Peel. I'm so happy with the results! My skin feels soft and is younger and fresher looking. I think as I just turned 50, my changing skin needed a change of peel. I may choose to alternate peels in the future.

avis.titre: Be very careful if you have sensitive skin!
avis.texte: I used this as directed on clean skin after showering, and after two minutes looked like I had a horrible sunburn on my face and neck! I washed it off twice with cold water and still look ridiculous an hour later. Do not use this product if you are fair or light complected! This has never happened to me before with any cosmetic product I've used; exfoliatiors, peels, masks, you name it.

I love these pads for keeping my face bright and my pores tight. Ingredients wise these pads aren't really that strong and a peel by The Ordinary that I use is better for stronger results but these are just for a quick brightening of the skin when I'm looking a bit uneven.

I'm 25 years old, I have suffered from acne for about 10 years now so I although my skin is now in a much better place the scarring left behind was BAD! I had red spots practically covering both my cheeks entirely. I refused to leave my house without makeup on. It was my biggest insecurity. I purchased these pads with the hope of brightening my acne scars and omg they have helped so much! After using 1 pad every week for a month my boyfriend started noticing the scars getting lighter and skin evening out. I'm now almost done with my second pack and rarely ever wear make up now. Of course all the scarring is not completely gone (10 yrs of acne remember) BUT its gotten drastically better. All I do now is dab concealer on certain spots and I'm out the door. Its given me so much more confidence and I will keep purchasing when I run out. These pads are pricey but worth it!
I have used this product for years. It keeps my skin bright, youthful, and refreshed.
Convenient, effective, and like that they're individually wrapped to stay fresh (vs. fluid in a bottle always being opened/closed).
I really love using these pads they make my skin luminous and help with the overall appearance of my skin! My face looks awesome! Skins super tight!

I have been using this product weekly for about 2years. Being skeptical initially, I used on my face, neck, chest, and back of hands- yes, there is that much product on a single pad that I can saturate my face and still have plenty for elsewhere. After a few weeks I noticed that a rough patch I've had on my hand for over a year started shrinking! Nothing I had tried previously worked and my dermatologist told me I might have it forever and not worry about it. It is now nearly gone! Although I'm not sure if it's actually lightening my age spots or if it's just wishful thinking on my part, but I am positive that my skin is looking wonderful and I credit my Philosophy products for this!

I absolutely love these pads. I ran out and went without for a while and noticed my face was just not the same. I finally purchased them again and I am so happy with the glow it gives my skin. I will never go without again.

I have been using this product for years and I stock up whenever I can. I do at least one peel a week. I have noticed a diminishing of my sun spots on my face. I would recommend this to anyone who wants to improve their overall skin tone and lessen their sun damage. I use in the morning after my shower and don't put on any other skin care products for the rest of that day.

My girlfriend gave me her box because it was too harsh on her sensitive skin but I lucked out and this actually works! My skin has never looked brighter and more evenly toned my dark spots and fine lines are even fading. I love these!
I bought the product and each use my skin was glowing and even helped to keep it even. Love if.
I have been using Microdelivery pads for years. At 75, my skin is fabulous!

I have been faithfully using this product for just over a year now. I absolutely love the results and always look forward to using it as part of my once a week beauty routine. The pre-moistened pads are very easy to use, and after cleansing my face, I use the pads on the back of my hands and elbows. It does take several uses to really notice an appreciable difference, but it is definitely worth the wait. It leaves my skin feeling so clean, and it has certainly lessened the appearance of dark spots I once had on my cheeks. The fragrance is not great, but is easy to tolerate knowing the wonderful difference it makes with each use. Although I never feel dry after using, you can follow up with a moisturizer if needed. My only complaint is the price, it is quite expensive at around $3 per use. Otherwise, I just can't say enough about this products and highly recommend it!
Easy to use, non-irritating AND actually makes a difference in skin texture and appearance. I do not feel like I need regular facials when I use these peel pads. They are WORTH every penny.

I was happily surprised at how brightened my skin was the morning after using The Microdelivery the first time. It's just an easy one step application with the saturated pad. It is a permanent part of my skincare regimen.
I love these pads! I've used consistently and I've noticed results. My skin is brighter and smoother definitely recommend!
After first use I noticed a difference in my skin. I would highly recommend.
I don't notice any difference what so ever and I slept with it on my face all night. It's been a few days, I'm going to try it again tonight and see what happens.

I've been using this product for four weeks. I saw a definite lightening after week one. I'm not sure that it has contunued to lighten but it has evened out my skin tone a bit. My skin loooooves Philosophy. It looks so much happier and healthier. I definitely recommend this product.

I've tried a lot of peels over the years and this is by far the easiest one and gets great results. I've found that if a skin treatment has too many steps &/or takes too long, I tend to skip it. With this product, I just cleanse and then swipe the pad with the peel treatment over my face, neck, chest and backs of hands. So easy!
I used this once before and this is my second purchase and I believe it will finish evening or my skin tone.

I am 42yrs. old and started having noticeable signs of aging around 35. Although I love skincare and makeup products, the older I get the more minimalistic I become. For my wrinkles I have always used Hope and Prayer vitamin C powder (b/c it is superior to any other vitamin C product available & b/c I get immediate visual results!) But recently I have have just felt drab looking. I do exfoliate daily w/micro delivery wash, but I knew I needed something extra. I have only used this peel 4 x's over the past 4 weeks and my skin is DRAMATICALLY different! I honestly feel radiant! I normally wear minimal foundation on a daily basis mixed w/my sunscreen but I don't even feel the need for foundation this past week! I have not felt this liberated since I was in my 20's and early 30's! Such a great feeling! My husband has also commented (MORE THAN ONCE!) how great my skin looks. I'm SO happy I tried this product! I wish it were a little less pricey but at least it delivers!!! I definitely recommend this product!

I began using this product 3 weeks ago. I didn't notice a change the first use, but last night I noticed how clean, clear, even, bright, & glowy my face looked! I had dark acne scars that I always used concealer to cover up. Now, the majority of those spots are gone & the ones that aren't quite diminished, have definitely faded! I no longer need to use concealer! My fianc? noticed how great my face looked & thought that I actually had makeup on. This amazing product has definitely bestowed more confidence in myself. I use it once a week before bed & don't wear makeup the next day, just to give my face a rest. I also use a sunscreen each time I know I'll be outside for long periods of time. This product does have a strong odor, but after 10 minutes or so, it seems to no longer be there. Philosophy outdid themselves, yet again, on this one!
This peel is awesome and so very easy to use. My 60 year old skin is absolutely loving this product. Not harsh at all; but works wonders. A keeper for sure.

I absolutely love this product. I use it every Sunday evening after washing my face and avoiding close to the eyes. Pre-soaked pad and super easy to use on face/neck. After a few Sundays, you will see the difference in the texture, lines, etc. I finish what's left on the pad on the top of my hands and elbows

After enjoying much success with Philosophy's Microdelivery Exfoliating Wash, I was eager to try these pads. Unfortunately, lightning didn't strike twice. The pads were soaking wet, and were just gross to apply as they dampened my face considerably. I figured my face would magically dry, like when applying a toner. This was not the case, and I was left with a sticky film all over my face. After 20 minutes or so, I could not deal with the film because firstly it was a less than pleasant feeling and secondly I was afraid of breaking out. So, I washed it off and figured I'd give the product another go the next day. Well, all hopes were dashed when I woke up and found several red bumps on my forehead. I wanted this to improve my skin, not make it worse! I read a review by Paula Begoun and she noted that the oils in this product could irritate one's skin. Oils? Irritate? No thank you. I thought that I'd be a Philosophy convert after using the exfoliating wash, but I guess Philosophy is like every other brand I've tried: it's hit or miss.
Works really well, my skin looks flowy and bright after first use. Does have strong smell but it doesn't linger in your face. Feels slightly sticky after but the effect is really nice.

I've heard a lot of great things about this acid peel. So I decided to give it a try. First thing I immediately noticed was a very strong vinegar odor. I am one of those people who don't like the smell of vinegar . Then there's a little bit of stinging sinsation kind of like pop rocks going off on your skin. After that your skin feels sticky until you wash the mask off.

Needed a change to my weekly routine, so I bought these yesterday not knowing how effective this product would be. I'm so glad I did, because after one use, I do see and feel a difference. Now that I am here on the site, I am overwhelmed by the many products available and can't wait to try more. Best peel ever. I love it!

I've used this product twice and so far I'm loving it! I think after the full 12 weeks, my skin will definitely be brighter and smoother. I will say the scent is antiseptic and not pleasing to me, but not a deal breaker. Definitely be careful if you get facial waxing done or tan - this makes skin so much more sensitive to trauma and sun exposure.

I use one of these pads once weekly, and have been for about one year now. I prefer to use them on a day I don't have to apply a moisturizer or make-up, in order to reap the most benefit from them. There is enough moisture on the pad for me to do my face, neck, chest and hands. The smell could be better, but they work. My pores are nearly invisible, and my skin is fresh and new looking. Thanks for these. They make giving myself a peel much simpler.

avis.titre: A splurge that became a necessity
avis.texte: This was not an easy purchase for me to make. I have a very hard time buying things for myself but I decided I wanted to give this product a try because my other philosophy products have done amazing things for my skin. I will never be without these pads. I have discoloration from the sun and old acne. I noticed a difference in my skin tone after just one use and it continues to get better each week! I look forward to using this product every Friday. I have dry, sensitive skin and have had no irritation from these. I just swipe the pad on my face and follow up with moisturizer. I need less foundation and concealer every week.
I love these, brightening peel on the go. When you don't have enough time for microdermabrasion, these are your go to!!!!

These little pads have a lot of power! My skin had really started looking dull, blotchy & just suffering from the winter issues that I deal with every year. I was told about these amazing pads & purchased them. After one use, my skin looked brighter, the redness had vanished & my pores looked visibly smaller. I won't be without these ever again! I use what's left over on the pad (they're soaked) on the back of my hands :) I've been a "Philosophy Girl" for over 10 years and it just keeps getting better! No one ever guesses my age (I'm 47 & a grandmother of 4) and I get compliments on my skin! I highly recommend this product!

I ordered this product because I suddenly remembered what success I had when using it several years ago. It works gently to rid the user of discolorations/dark spots. I find I don't need to use this product every night. A few nights a week usually is enough for me to have noticeable improvement. I use this product at bed time to help avoid sun exposure. My skin is a bit sensitive when using this product. The smell is not pleasant, but it goes away after the product dries. If it didn't work so well, I don't think I could tolerate the scent or price. I have adult acne-prone dark skin that is given to hyperpigmentation. I experience noborritation when using this product. I would repurchase and recommend.
Only two weeks in but skin is brighter and it's a great compliment to my new daily regimin.

For years I was riddled with acne scars, and nothing would lighten them even the prescription variety medication from my position and the expensive formulas from the dermatologist. I have tried everything from Retin-A to chemical peels. Nothing works like these pads! They get rid of acne scars and just a few uses. If you have red marks of any kind they will lighten it quickly. If I have a bad acne scar I will use this two or three times a week, rubbing the scar most and then smoothing around the whole face. It is important to note that there is no visible peeling with this product. It is more of an exfoliation overtime tool than an actual peel. No one will even know you've used it and your makeup will still look the great the next day, but your complexion willlook somehow more translucent and brighter. Don't wait on the fence for this product because it is worth every penny. Philosophy please never stop making this product because I seriously cannot live without it! It has changed my life.... I don't hide acne scars anymore with concealer. I wipe them away with this!

I've been using these once a week as recommended for a few years now and would not be without them. 30 seconds each week is all it takes and my skin is soft and smooth. I'm in my late 30's going into 40 soon and still experience the occasional hormonal breakouts. I find that as you age, it takes longer for any scarring to fade after a breakout. These peel pads truly help keep the skin bright and help fade these dark post-breakout marks over time for me. My skin is sensitive but I have no issues at all with these pads causing any irritation. I use these in the PM 1x per week and I follow with the renewed hope moisturizer. The pads are of a very generous size and saturated, so you'll even have enough for the back of your hands and elbows! I made the mistake of not reordering these in time. My skin really felt the difference and looked dull for the couple of weeks I went without, so I will not be without them again. Philosophy: please do not discontinue these...Please!

I have been having some skin issues lately (melasma, eczema, perioral dermatitis to name a few) and while this peel does not correct everything instantly I do wake up with skin that looks a lot better than it did the night before! I really do love this peel!

I have been having some skin issues lately (melasma, eczema, perioral dermatitis to name a few) and while this peel does not correct everything instantly I do wake up with skin that looks a lot better than it did the night before! I really do love this peel!
This brightening product is amazing, Used weekly, you can see the results. I get compliments all the time on how "fresh" my skin looks.
